rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person's reasoning ability or intellectual capacity.

example.english: Their intellect is very high; they understand complex concepts after one look.
example.traditional: 佢嘅智力好高，睇一次就明白複雜嘅概念。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ge3 zi3 lik6 hou2 gou1 tai2 jat1 ci3 zau6 ming4 baak6 fuk1 zaap6 ge3 koi3 nim6

rows.note: Use this for the general mental faculty or inner cognitive development rather than a person's measured intellectual capacity.

example.english: Education is crucial to the development of children's intellect.
example.traditional: 教育對兒童心智發展好重要。
example.jyutping: gaau3 juk6 deoi3 ji4 tung4 sam1 zi3 faat3 zin2 hou2 zung6 jiu3

rows.note: Use this for an intellectual person, especially as a member of the educated or intellectual class.

example.english: That person is an intellect who has long cared about social justice.
example.traditional: 嗰位知識分子長年關心社會公義。
example.jyutping: go2 wai6 zi1 sik1 fan6 zi2 coeng4 nin4 gwaan1 sam1 se5 wui2 gung1 ji6
